title: Data Cleanliness
definition: Ensuring the data used in AI models is clean, normalized, and well-structured, to improve the performance and reliability of the models.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Making sure data is tidy and easy to understand, so AI models can learn effectively.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Cleaning, normalizing, and structuring data to reduce noise, eliminate errors, and facilitate the training of AI models.
difficulty_levels.expert: Recognizing the importance of high-quality data in AI model training, and implementing strategies to ensure the data is as clean, complete, and representative as possible.

extra_fields.insight: A clean data set is the foundation for accurate AI models.
